description: Profile normalization boundaries: a plural emails array maps every entry into the email collection; a record carrying both user-id and subject prefers the user-id as identifier; an identities list supplies the provider even when the identifier has no vertical-bar prefix; the first of several identity entries wins; a record with only a family name leaves the given name absent; and a non-string numeric identifier is kept verbatim but yields no provider.

cases.expected_output:
id=plain
user_id=plain
displayName=(none)
provider=(none)
givenName=(none)
familyName=(none)
emails=a@x.com,b@x.com

id=auth0|111
user_id=auth0|111
displayName=Bob
provider=auth0
givenName=Bob
familyName=Lee
emails=bob@x.com

id=u-123
user_id=u-123
displayName=Al
provider=google-oauth2
givenName=(none)
familyName=(none)
emails=al@x.com

id=facebook|999
user_id=facebook|999
displayName=X
provider=facebook
givenName=(none)
familyName=(none)
emails=(none)

id=plain2
